sources.primary_title: NTT DATA to showcase AI-powered intelligent ecosystems at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: NTT DATA has confirmed its participation in LEAP 2026, running from August 31 to September 3 in Riyadh, where it will present AI-powered intelligent infrastructure and digital transformation solutions. Aligned with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 and the Kingdom's designation of 2026 as the 'Year of AI,' the company will focus on the theme 'Cities that Think: How AI is Reshaping the Future of Urban Life.' The showcase will highlight sovereign AI, agentic AI, smart cities, digital twins, robotics, and cloud solutions. The company is also emphasizing its strengthened regional capabilities following the acquisition of Zero&One. Key executives, including Burcak Soydan and Rami Beidas, will participate in high-profile speaking sessions addressing AI advantage and enterprise IT transformation.
sources.verified_key_facts: NTT DATA is participating in LEAP 2026 in Riyadh from August 31 to September 3, 2026; The showcase theme is 'Cities that Think: How AI is Reshaping the Future of Urban Life'; Key focus areas include sovereign AI, agentic AI, smart cities, digital twins, robotics, AIOps, cloud, and cybersecurity; The announcement aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 and its $40 billion AI fund; NTT DATA recently acquired Zero&One to enhance its AI and cloud services in the Middle East and Africa; Denzil Samuels, Burcak Soydan, and Bill Wilson are scheduled to speak at the event; Visitors can find NTT DATA at Hall 1, Stand C60.
